listings.Job Description: Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions. Apply now for the internship program in Business Administration (6 months) to join our team based in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This internship program will allow you to provide quality support for the Middle East and Africa Customers Services Central Offer Desk. You will be responsible for a variety of tasks. These are intended to provide you with operational experience as well as an overview in the different functions with the MEA Business Management Team.
listings.Job Requirements: Pursuing Bachelor's Degree or Master’s Degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or equivalent. Experience in bid proposal, tender management and operations is an advantage. Fluent in English. Fluency in Arabic is an additional advantage. Good Team Player with strong interpersonal and negotiation skills. Good time management skills, Ability to multi-task and work under pressure in a cross functional setting. You have good PC skills (MS Office software like Word, PowerPoint, Excel and Outlook).
